name: Akroan Legion
blurb: Disciplined soldiers and heroic strikes — a balanced Theros force.
blurbZh: 纪律严明的士兵与英雄纪元攻势——均衡的塞洛斯军队。

roster.name: Akroan Hoplite
roster.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of attacking creatures you control.
roster.oracleTextZh: 每当此生物攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为攻击中由你操控的生物数量。

roster.name: Observant Alseid
Setessan Oathsworn
roster.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
roster.oracleTextZh: 英雄纪元～每当你施放以本生物为目标的咒语时，在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

roster.name: Centaur Battlemaster
roster.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put three +1/+1 counters on this creature.
roster.oracleTextZh: 英雄纪元～每当你施放以本生物为目标的咒语时，在其上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

roster.name: Fleecemane Lion
roster.oracleText:
{3}{G}{W}: Monstrosity 1.
As long as this creature is monstrous, it has hexproof and indestructible.
roster.oracleTextZh:
{3}{G}{W}：蛮化1。
只要此生物已蛮化，它便具有辟邪与不灭异能。

roster.name: Polukranos, World Eater
roster.oracleText: {X}{X}{G}: Monstrosity X. When it becomes monstrous, divide X damage among creatures.
roster.oracleTextZh: {X}{X}{G}：蛮化X。当它成为蛮化时，将X点伤害任意分配给若干生物。
